idea: Make the Ralph plugin runtime enforce exact surface-based model routing: UI work uses claude-opus-4.8, all non-UI work uses gpt-5.6-sol, mixed work splits by story/call where practical and otherwise uses Opus, with no GPT-5.5 or implicit model default.
method: Single-owner source audit of Ralph runtime, source skills, generator/lowering code, generated Copilot/Codex artifacts, schemas, tests, and release surfaces. Nested delegation was intentionally not used.

candidateDirections.name: Central fail-closed router plus structured work-surface propagation
candidateDirections.summary: Add one model-routing module, persist workSurface across brainstorm/plan/PRD/story/review boundaries, validate engine compatibility, require every wrapper and generated Task call to resolve an approved exact model, inventory all dispatch sites, and regenerate artifacts.

candidateDirections.name: Literal model-ID replacement sweep
candidateDirections.summary: Replace GPT-5.5/GPT-5.4/Opus-4.7 strings in place without adding structured surface metadata.
candidateDirections.reason: Engine branches would still decide the model, mixed jobs would not split, missing/default callsites would remain, and future drift would be uncontrolled.

candidateDirections.name: Codex means GPT, Copilot means Opus
candidateDirections.summary: Keep current engine-driven routing and update each engine to one approved model.
candidateDirections.reason: The operator policy is surface-based. Copilot must run GPT for non-UI work, and UI through Codex is not safely portable.

classification.mixedBehavior: Require per-story workSurface for executable stories; an unsplittable mixed story or whole-job judgment uses Opus.

nextStagePlanSeed.goal: Release Ralph 5.63.0 with fail-closed, exact, surface-based model routing across subprocess wrappers, iteration/review loops, source skills, generated Copilot Task calls, custom-agent YAML, and generated Codex artifacts.

stories.title: Add central model policy and durable work-surface schema
acceptance: Only ui, non-ui, and mixed are accepted.
Exact mapping is UI/mixed to claude-opus-4.8 and non-UI to gpt-5.6-sol.
Missing classification fails; mixed PRDs require per-story classification.

stories.title: Route wrappers, iterations, planning, and re-review through the policy
acceptance: Copilot UI uses claude-opus-4.8.
Codex and Copilot non-UI use gpt-5.6-sol.
UI plus Codex is rejected before spawn.
No raw arbitrary-model fallback exists.

stories.title: Propagate surface through source skills and nested workflows
acceptance: Every wrapper call receives a structured surface.
Every direct Task path resolves and pins an exact approved model.
Nested workflow calls carry the surface.
Review attribution no longer mislabels a GPT reviewer as Opus.

stories.title: Make generator and generated artifacts policy-aware
scope: plugins/ralph/scripts/codex-lowering.mjs or a new routing-site inventory
acceptance: Generated YAML contains only the two approved IDs.
Every generated Copilot task call has explicit model routing.
Every dispatch site is inventory-covered.
Generated parity checks pass.

stories.title: Add routing, migration, parity, and stale-model regression tests
acceptance: Representative UI/non-UI/mixed dispatches assert exact IDs.
Missing/default/GPT-5.5 paths are rejected.
Generated source parity is clean.
A scan rejects GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and Opus-4.7 in active surfaces.

stories.title: Ship Ralph 5.63.0 and dogfood installed routing
acceptance: All release gates pass.
Installed Copilot plugin runs a non-UI GPT-5.6 Sol flow and a UI Opus 4.8 flow.
Codex runs a non-UI GPT-5.6 Sol flow.
Unavailable models fail closed without fallback.

risks: Nested Skill and prose-only Agent callsites can be missed without a stable inventory.
Custom agent YAML may override an explicit Task model; run a Phase-0 installed CLI probe and generate surface variants if needed.
Existing jobs lack workSurface and require a one-time explicit migration.
UI through Codex is feature/version-gated; keep it out of the minimal release.
Same-plugin Ralph work conflicts on generator, skills, AGENTS, CHANGELOG, generated trees, and version stamps.
deferred: Optional future support for Opus 4.8 through Codex after version/gate compatibility is designed and tested.
Optional structured pre-PRD surface-slice maps for splitting mixed brainstorm/plan lenses more finely than story boundaries.
